title: Revenue Accounting Definition: Fare Carried by the Direction Changed on a Same-Day Exchange
content:
**Definition — Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand.** For a same-day confirmed exchange, *the fare the changed direction carries* is measured by one of three conventions set by the state of the ticket.

| State of the ticket | Fare the changed direction carries |
|---|---|
| At least one flown coupon | The fare collected less the coupon value already flown |
| Round-trip ticket with no flown coupon | Half the fare collected |
| Any other ticket (a one-way ticket with no flown coupon) | The whole fare collected |

The fare collected is every fare-collection and add-collect entry on the ticket; the coupon value already flown is every flown-coupon entry on it. The first row applies whenever a coupon has been flown, whether the ticket is one-way or round-trip.

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

| Ticket | Fare collected | Coupon value flown | Fare the changed direction carries |
|---|---|---|---|
| Round trip, outbound flown | 520.00 | 240.00 | 280.00 |
| Round trip, nothing flown | 520.00 | 0 | 260.00 |
| One way, nothing flown | 310.00 | 0 | 310.00 |
| One way with two segments, first flown | 410.00 | 150.00 | 260.00 |
